paragraphs: NovoaGlobal sells photo enforcement systems, including red light and school zone speed enforcement, which the company describes as designed to improve traffic safety and reduce road injuries and fatalities. Public Safety products add real time tracking and monitoring, and Vision Zero products cover crosswalk, railroad, and stop sign driver education. Named systems on the site include School Zone Speed-Safe, Crosswalk-Safe, RedLight-Safe, StopSign-Safe, and Railroad-Safe.

A post listed under Solutions describes automated oversize vehicle detection provided to Belle Isle, Florida. One post says Sensys America developed Railroad-Safe in response to a request by the City of Orlando for a rail-highway grade crossing detection system. The affiliations page states a Strategic Partner relationship with NLETS and MBE certification in various States, Counties and Cities.

quote.text: NovoaGlobal's mission is to provide non-complex solutions that help organizations to make better use of technology.
